title: Austin Election Runoff Results Certified
meeting_type: Austin City Council Special Called Meeting
summary:
*   The Austin City Council held a special meeting to officially certify the results of the December 15, 2020 runoff election.
*   Mackenzie Kelly was confirmed as the winner for the District 6 City Council seat.
*   Alison Alter was confirmed as the winner for the District 10 City Council seat.
